text:
emily: Rolling v2.20.0 into eu-west-3 (canary). Starting lightweight post-deploy smoke probes now. Will monitor for 15m.

deploy-bot: canary applied at 2% traffic to eu-west-3. All readiness probes passing. invoking synth short-suite.

ops-bot: synth short-suite: 12/12 checks OK, p50=41ms p95=105ms errors=0. No obvious regressions.

kevin: Noticed a cluster of transient 503s from prefill-eu-west-3 around 14:22:05 UTC; small sample pasted: 
```
14:22:03 prefill-eu-3 pod=pf-12 status=200 t=39ms
14:22:05 prefill-eu-3 pod=pf-12 status=503 t=72ms reason=upstream_overload
14:22:07 prefill-eu-2 pod=pf-08 status=200 t=36ms
```

emily: Thanks. Can we correlate to CPU or OOMs on model-serve nodepool? If this is only prefill, we could pin embed routes and hold ramp. Proposal: hold global ramp, keep canary at 2% for 30m, pin non-critical routes in eu-west-3 to v2.19.x. If 503s exceed 0.5% for 5m -> rollback to v2.19.9.

maria: Correlate bot: 7/20 503s are from nodepool model-serve-eu-1, CPU peaked at 14:21:50. No restarts. I've queued a memory caution patch on the prefiller to back off prefill concurrency: `kubectl set env deploy/prefill PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=4 -n eu-west-3`

ops-bot: extended-suite queued; ETA ~12m. Watch rule: prefiller.503.rate > 0.5% for 5m -> oncall.

emily: Decision: pause staged ramp. Pin eu-west-3 embed/non-critical routes to v2.19.x. Owners: maria (mitigation), kevin (logs), ops-bot (alerts). Re-evaluate in 15m. Release note: "Prefill concurrency adjustment; monitoring added for prefiller 503 spikes."

deploy-bot: rollout paused by emily. pin set: eu-west-3 -> v2.20.0 at 2% until 3123458650.

kevin: I'll post back with extended-suite output and any further anomalies.

emily: Thanks team. If extended-suite stays green and 503s don't recur, we'll resume ramp in the next change window.
